verdict.rationale: Docs confirm balance accounts hold/segregate funds per user and describe payout timing, splits, and reconciliation reports, giving some visibility into where in-flight and held funds sit. However, there is no mention of whether balances earn yield/interest, and no explicit statement on legal/regulatory segregation of platform funds from Adyen's own corporate accounts (safeguarding, e-money regulations, etc.). missing for 10: yield/interest treatment on balances, explicit fund-segregation/safeguarding disclosures, independent audit or regulatory confirmation of asset protection.
